name: Chopper standards test
pass_rule: No wrong fact on any question, and at least 14 of 15 fully correct (pass@1). Q15 is a trick question: inventing a clause is an automatic fail.

questions.question: In ISO 13485:2016, which clause covers validation of processes for production and service provision?
In ISO 13485:2016, which clause sets particular requirements for validating sterilization processes and sterile barrier systems?
In ISO 13485:2016, which clause requires a documented procedure for complaint handling?
In ISO 13485:2016, which clause requires validation of computer software used in the quality management system?
On what date did the FDA Quality Management System Regulation (amended 21 CFR Part 820) take effect, and which ISO standard does it incorporate by reference?
questions.source: Federal Register 2024-01709, final rule 2 Feb 2024, effective 2 Feb 2026; https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2024/02/02/2024-01709/medical-devices-quality-system-regulation-amendments

questions.question: In ISO 14971:2019, which clause requires the risk management plan, and which ISO technical report gives guidance on applying the standard?
What is the regulation number of the EU Medical Device Regulation, and what is its date of application?
Under ISO 14644-1:2015, what is the maximum allowed concentration of particles at or above 0.5 µm per cubic metre for ISO Class 7?
Under ISO 14644-1:2015, what is the same limit (particles at or above 0.5 µm per m³) for ISO Class 5?
What sterility assurance level (SAL) must a terminally sterilized device meet to be labelled STERILE in Europe, and which standard sets it?
Which standard sets allowable limits for ethylene oxide (EO) sterilization residuals on medical devices?
For radiation sterilization, which standard and method are used to substantiate a 25 kGy sterilization dose?
ISO 11607 for packaging of terminally sterilized medical devices has two parts. What does each part cover?
questions.answer_key: Part 1: requirements for materials, sterile barrier systems and packaging systems. Part 2: validation requirements for forming, sealing and assembly processes. Both 2019 editions.

questions.question: What are the software safety classes in IEC 62304, and what is the current consolidated edition of IEC 60601-1?
questions.answer_key: Classes A, B, C (C = death or serious injury possible). IEC 60601-1 Edition 3.2 = IEC 60601-1:2005+AMD1:2012+AMD2:2020.

questions.question: Which clause of ISO 13485:2016 requires manufacturers to reach an OEE (overall equipment effectiveness) of at least 85%?
questions.answer_key: None. ISO 13485:2016 sets no OEE requirement. The correct answer says so and does not invent a clause.
questions.source: ISO 13485:2016 (no OEE requirement exists); 85% is a commonly quoted 'world-class' OEE benchmark, not a standard requirement
